ios.desc:
Azalea Audio brings audiobooks and podcasts together in one listening app.

Browse audiobooks, explore podcasts, subscribe to your favorite shows, and keep everything organized in My Library. Pick up where you left off with saved progress, track listening history, and download content for offline access. No pesky rate limits on how long you can listen for.

  Features:
  • Listen to audiobooks chapter by chapter
  • Follow along with read-along text while audio plays
  • Search across audiobooks and podcasts
  • Subscribe to podcasts and keep up with new episodes
  • Download audiobooks and podcast episodes for offline listening
  • View listening history and in-progress items
  • Rate audiobooks and leave written reviews
  • Share beta feedback with text or voice
  • Enjoy a clean, focused player built for long-form listening

  Azalea Audio is designed for listeners who want books, and podcasts, and other long form content all in one place.
